parts.label: National tide
why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.68 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 23.5 points of that tide, a tailwind for Troy Carter.

D.t: Troy Carter leads by 67.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 172,673 votes; a one point swing is about 1,288 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +60.1 and D +73.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
